summary.text: Setting up OAuth for Notion involves several clear steps, including creating a public connection in the Developer portal, configuring redirect URIs and scopes, and following a standard OAuth authorization and token exchange flow.
summary.label: sourced

sources.quote: Navigate to the Developer portal and create a new public connection. Fill out the form with your connection details, including your redirect URI(s) under the OAuth configuration section and the connection’s installation scope — either Any workspace or Selected workspaces only. This can’t be changed after creation. The redirect URI is the URI your users will be redirected to after authorizing the public connection. To learn more, read OAuth’s description of redirect URIs.

limits.text: Each Notion API connection has a rate limit of 600 requests per minute for Business and Enterprise workspaces, and 180 requests per minute for all other plans.
limits.label: sourced

sources.quote:
Each connection has a fixed budget of requests per 60-second window, based on the workspace’s plan:
| Workspace plan | Limit |
 --- |
| Business and Enterprise | 600 requests per minute (an average of 10 per second) |
| All other plans | 180 requests per minute (an average of 3 per second) |

limits.text: A separate per-workspace rate limit is shared across all connections and is scaled to the workspace’s plan.
limits.label: sourced

sources.quote: A separate limit is shared across all of the workspace’s connections and scaled to the workspace’s plan. Because it’s shared, requests can be rate limited even when each individual connection is within its per-connection limit.

limits.text: Querying a data source has a separate limit of about 3 requests per second per connection.
limits.label: sourced

sources.quote: Querying a data source has a separate limit of about 3 requests per second per connection.

limits.text: A single request payload can contain a maximum of 1000 block elements and must not exceed 500KB in size.
limits.label: sourced

sources.quote: Note that in addition to the property limits below, payloads have a maximum size of 1000 block elements and 500KB overall.

limits.text: Rich text content and URLs in Notion API requests are limited to 2000 characters each.
limits.label: sourced

sources.quote:
| Rich text object | text.content | 2000 characters |
| Rich text object | text.link.url | 2000 characters |

limits.text: Arrays of all block types, including rich text objects, are limited to 100 elements per request.
limits.label: sourced
